frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Loading up / freighting to capacity — the act or resultant state of a vessel being packed with its cargo and passengers. The root residue is "being laden/freighted": filled by having a load put into it, not merely spatially full.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Loading up / freighting to capacity — the act or resultant state of a vessel being packed with its cargo and passengers. The root residue is "being laden/freighted": filled by having a load put into it, not merely spatially full.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root ش ح ن occurs in the Quran only three times, and in every case it is the same word: مَشْحُون, the passive participle describing الفلك (the ship) — "the laden ship." In 26:119 it is Noah's ark that saves him and those with him; in 36:41 it is the loaded ship carrying people's offspring as a sign; in 37:140 it is the ship Jonah flees to. Across all three the ship is characterized as loaded/freighted — packed with its load of people (and by narrative implication provisions/animals). The root's contribution across the full set is the notion of being loaded up to full capacity.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM (مَفْعُول passive participle): contributes "having had X done to it" — the ship is the patient of the loading action, a resultant state, not an agent. CONSTRUCTION: definite attributive adjective modifying الفلك, i.e. an epithet of the ship. CONTEXT: all three sit in sea/ark deliverance narratives (Noah; a generic sign of divine carrying; Jonah), supplying the voyage/salvation framing which is NOT part of the root. Subtracting these layers, the ROOT residue is the bare idea of loading/freighting to capacity — a vessel packed with its load. Caveat: the root surfaces in only one form and one collocation, so this subtraction cannot be independently cross-checked against other forms of the same root.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: There is no resistant occurrence — all three tokens are the literally identical word مَشْحُون. The real weakness is not a counterexample but the total absence of variation: the root never appears outside الفلك المشحون, so nothing tests whether the residue is "loading with freight" specifically versus a more generic "filled/full." A hostile reading could claim the three tokens are one frozen lexical fossil, not evidence of a productive root contribution.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Nearest competitor is the generic "fill" sense (cf. مَلَأ, to fill). One could argue the residue is merely "full/filled," with "cargo/loading" supplied entirely by the ship context. Against this: the passive participle here consistently frames the ship as the recipient of a deliberate loading act (people carried aboard — reinforced by حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ in 36:41), which favors "laden/freighted" (a load put in) over neutral spatial "fullness." But with only one collocation, this distinction cannot be decisively proven from the packet alone.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinctive residue vs مَلَأ (fill a space with any substance/quality) and حَمَل (carry a burden): ش ح ن profiles the vessel as loaded up with a freight to capacity — the patient-state of having cargo/passengers put into it. It is not "carrying" (agentive transport, حمل) nor abstract "filling" (ملأ); it is the resultant laden condition of a container that has been freighted. Falsifiable: if a future confirmed occurrence used مشحون / any ش ح ن form for something filled with a non-load quality (e.g. filled with light, anger) without a loading/freighting event, the residue would fail.
internal_discovery.rationale: Universal presence holds trivially and completely: all 3/3 confirmed occurrences are the identical passive participle مَشْحُون, and the candidate contribution (being loaded/freighted to capacity) is demonstrably present in every one after subtracting the مَفْعُول form, the attributive construction, and the ark-narrative context. There is no resistant or anomalous occurrence, so the result is PREFERRED rather than UNRESOLVED. Strength is MODERATE, not STRONG, because the entire evidence base is a single frozen collocation (الفلك المشحون) in one morphological form with zero internal variation — the root's contribution cannot be triangulated across differing forms, participants, or constructions, so the separation of root residue from construction/context is asserted but not independently corroborated within the packet.

adversarial_verification.notes: All 3 confirmed occurrences (26:119, 36:41, 37:140) are the identical construction: Form I passive participle al-mashHun ('the laden') modifying al-fulk ('the ship'). The proposed residue 'being laden/freighted — filled by having a load put into it, not merely spatially full' is demonstrably present in each: a vessel loaded with people/animals (26:119), offspring/cargo (36:41), and cargo (37:140). No failing occurrence found. Distinctiveness is internally corroborated at 36:41, where HamalnA ('We carried') co-occurs with al-mashHun, separating shHn (laden state of the vessel) from Hml (act of carrying) and from mal>a (merely spatially full). Falsifiable: predicts a loaded vessel at every occurrence; no counter-instance in packet. Caveat: the set is homogeneous (one form, one construction, one collocate), so universal presence holds but is only stress-tested within the ship-lading context; there is no independent variation to further probe the residue. The 'to capacity' phrasing in the proposal is not lexicalized by mashHun ('laden/loaded'), but the stated core residue holds in all three.
